title: Using the 2D Driver Console
summary: Start a session, operate controls, and observe the shared engine state in the 2D simulator.

steps.title: Open the 2D simulator
steps.body: Navigate to Simulators → 2D and start a session.

steps.title: Identify the controls
steps.body: Find the 13-position master handle, left/right passenger door banks with ENABLE, OPEN and CLOSE buttons, Security Brake and emergency-release control.

steps.title: Practice door closure
steps.body: At standstill with handle N, enable one door bank, open it, close it, and confirm the All Doors Closed indication when both sides are secured.

steps.title: Apply power or braking
steps.body: Request P1–P4 or B1–B7 and observe the simulated speed and handle indication.

steps.title: Review safety response
steps.body: Activate EB, stop, return the handle to N, request emergency release and observe the three-second release.

notes: Control inputs can be rejected by the Simulation Engine.
The 2D and 3D interfaces reflect the same active browser simulation session.
